mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates robust economic growth that elevates corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate is positive in the latest quarter but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 9.0% for three consecutive months, it signals severe labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE > 9.0% for 3 consecutive months, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening labor demand and consumer confidence, which jointly drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in UNRATE and rise in RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), an increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening that suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% periods, FEDFUNDS increases do not produce negative 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output that correlates with stronger corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth in the latest month is positive but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 600,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where HOUST < 600.0 for 2 consecutive months, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY < 1.5%), a decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL YoY < 1.5% periods, FEDFUNDS declines do not produce positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During high labor market slack (UNRATE > 8.5% and PAYEMS YoY growth < 0.5%), a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor demand recovery that boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In high labor market slack regimes, UNRATE declines fail to produce positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of cases.
